Advanced ATC

A-Seviyesi Bakım Kontrolü

A scheduled, routine maintenance check performed at regular intervals to ensure the continued airworthiness of the aircraft, typically involving inspections and minor servicing tasks as prescribed by the maintenance program (ICAO Doc 9760, FAA Part 43).

Alan Navigasyonu Zorunlu Navigasyon Performansı

A navigation specification for aircraft that combines Area Navigation (RNAV) with defined Required Navigation Performance (RNP) standards, indicating the precision and monitoring required in a given airspace or procedure, in accordance with ICAO Doc 9613.

Terimi gor

Aletli İniş Sistemi Kategori II Yaklaşma

Precision approach using ILS equipment with decision height not lower than 100 ft and RVR not less than 300 m.

Terimi gor

Aletli İniş Sistemi Kategori IIIA Yaklaşma

ILS precision approach with decision height below 100 ft and RVR not less than 200 m; autopilot or HUD guidance required.

Terimi gor

Aletli İniş Sistemi Kategori IIIB Yaklaşma

ILS precision autoland with no decision height or below 50 ft and RVR as low as 75 m, requiring fail-operational capability.

Terimi gor

Alpha-Floor Koruması

Autothrust safeguard that commands maximum thrust if angle-of-attack approaches stall, preventing loss of lift.

Terimi gor

Asgari Teçhizat Listesi Muafiyeti

The operational allowance permitting dispatch or continued operation of an aircraft with certain inoperative items, as listed in the approved Minimum Equipment List (ICAO Doc 9760, MEL Policy).

Terimi gor

Aviyonik Ethernet Ağı

A high-speed, deterministic digital data network based on Ethernet technology, used to interconnect avionics systems on modern aircraft (ARINC 664, AFDX).

Terimi gor

Aviyonik Tam Çift Yönlü Anahtarlamalı Ethernet

A deterministic, high-speed, full-duplex switched Ethernet network designed specifically for critical avionics systems, providing reliable, low-latency data exchange between aircraft systems (ARINC 664, Part 7).

Terimi gor

Aviyoniklerde Taşıma Katmanı Güvenliği

The use of cryptographic protocols (TLS/SSL) to protect avionics network data in transit from unauthorized access or tampering (ICAO Doc 10117, EASA AMC 20-42).

Terimi gor

Aviyonikte Ethernet Üzerinden Güç

A system that delivers both power and data over Ethernet cables to avionics equipment, reducing wiring complexity and enabling flexible installations (ARINC 429, ARINC 664).

Terimi gor

Avrupa Jeostatik Navigasyon Katman Servisi

The European SBAS providing GNSS augmentation for safety-critical aviation operations, enabling APV and LPV approaches across Europe (ICAO Doc 9849, EASA AMC 20-28).

Terimi gor

Az İtişli Kalkış

Take-off using less than maximum rated thrust by performance calculation, saving engine life and fuel.

Terimi gor

Azaltılmış Dikey Ayırma Asgari Onayı

An official authorisation for an aircraft and operator to use Reduced Vertical Separation Minimum (RVSM) airspace, allowing reduced vertical separation of 1,000 feet between FL290 and FL410, in accordance with ICAO Doc 9574.

Baş Üstü Göstergesi

Transparent cockpit display showing critical flight data within the pilot’s forward field of view, reducing the need to look down at instruments.

Terimi gor

Beta-Target Koruması

Flight-laws function holding safe sideslip target during engine-out or crosswind approach to maintain directional control.

Terimi gor

Beşinci Nesil C-Bant Bağlantısı

A communications system using 5G cellular technology in the C-band spectrum for high-speed, low-latency data transfer to and from aircraft (ICAO GANP, SESAR).

Terimi gor

Bilgisayar Tabanlı Eğitim Kontrolü

A mandatory electronic assessment verifying that aircrew or ATC personnel have completed required computer-based training modules in accordance with regulatory standards (ICAO Doc 9868, EASA AMC1).

Terimi gor

Birleşme Noktası Sıralaması

A terminal arrival procedure in which aircraft from different routes are directed to a predefined merge point and sequenced for final approach (ICAO Doc 9931, FAA NextGen).

Terimi gor

Boreskop Motor Muayenesi

A maintenance procedure using a borescope device to visually inspect the internal components of an aircraft engine for defects or damage (FAA AC 33-6, EASA Part 145).

Terimi gor

Büyük Veri Analitiği

The use of advanced computing techniques to analyze vast amounts of operational data, supporting safety, efficiency, and predictive maintenance in aviation (ICAO Doc 10140).

C-Seviyesi Bakım Kontrolü

A comprehensive periodic maintenance inspection performed at longer intervals than A- or B-Checks, involving in-depth systems checks, component replacements, and structural inspections as prescribed by regulatory maintenance programs (ICAO Doc 9760, FAA Part 43).

Terimi gor

D-Seviyesi Ağır Bakım Kontrolü

An extensive, scheduled maintenance inspection that involves major disassembly, overhaul, and comprehensive structural and systems checks, typically performed every 6–12 years to ensure long-term airworthiness (ICAO Doc 9760, FAA Part 43).

Derate İtiş

Engine rated for lower maximum take-off thrust than certification limit, permanently reducing stress and maintenance costs.

Autoland logic able to complete flare, touchdown and rollout after any single-component failure below alert height.
